description: This file is a C header file defining the exported API for the Slap Owo Uoac object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It contains declarations of functions related to object creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization, intended to be used across multiple source files.

methods.name: SlapCreateOwoUoac
methods.description: Creates an Owo Uoac object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new Owo Uoac object with specified context handles.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Owo Uoac object.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the Owo Uoac instance.
